# Blossomforth

[![Blossomforth beside Thunderlane in Hurricane Fluttershy - Hasbro Studios](https://cdn.twibooru.org/img/view/2020/7/9/8958__safe_derpibooru%2Bimport_screencap_blossomforth_derpy%2Bhooves_dizzy%2Btwister_orange%2Bswirl_sunshower%2Braindrops_thunderlane_pegasus_pony_hurricane%2Bflut.png)](https://twibooru.org/8958)

Blossomforth is a Ponyville Pegasus mare best remembered for stretching herself into a pony pretzel during Rainbow Dash's flight training. She is an established minor character in the G4 Friendship is Magic television continuity.

- **Appearance:** Almost-white pinkish coat, magenta-and-green striped mane and tail, blue eyes, small cheek freckles, and two flowers in pink and aqua as her cutie mark. [Color reference](https://mlpvector.club/cg/pony/v/68-Blossomforth).
- **Naming:** An official Hasbro name, not a fandom invention. Her 2011 toy predates her 2012 television debut. The original product description establishes her love of sunshine and her job clearing clouds. She shares her name with a G3 Earth pony, a separate incarnation. [Merchandise archive](https://www.strawberryreef.com/Index/Name/blossomforthFIM.html).
- **Speaking status:** Named aloud by Rainbow Dash and heard coughing, but no confirmed spoken dialogue from her usual character design. Kelly Metzger was credited as Blossomforth in Rainbow Falls (S4E10), although Helia delivers the corresponding line on screen. Helia is a separate pony, not an alternate identity. [The Hub's original cast announcement](https://www.equestriadaily.com/2014/01/full-episode-synopsis-for-rainbow-falls.html?m=0).
- **Appearances:** Hurricane Fluttershy (S2E22), Rainbow Falls (S4E10; subject to the above credit discrepancy), Inspiration Manifestation (S4E23), and The One Where Pinkie Pie Knows (S5E19). In the latter, she sits with Thunderlane beneath a tree with a wrapped gift. Their relationship is not established as romantic. [Equestria Daily character spotlight](https://www.equestriadaily.com/2016/04/pony-spotlight-11-blossomforth.html). A cameo in IDW's Friends Forever #9 is also reported by the [character wiki](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Blossomforth), although the comic panel could not be independently inspected.

## Important moments

All three of her most distinctive moments occur in [Hurricane Fluttershy (S2E22)](https://tv.apple.com/us/episode/hurricane-fluttershy/umc.cmc.4gp44qpj6e47mnahmvdsqvpa7).

1. **Too much flexibility - S2E22.** Rainbow Dash calls Blossomforth by name and asks another pony to help untangle her, giving her a memorable comedic introduction.
2. **The concealed cough - S2E22.** Blossomforth giggles when Thunderlane is reprimanded for coughing, then tries to hide her own cough, foreshadowing the team's illness.
3. **Feather flu - S2E22.** Her absence alongside the other sick Pegasi contributes to the wing-power shortage that makes Fluttershy's participation so important.

[Episode transcript](https://transcripts.foreverdreaming.org/viewtopic.php?t=63927). Exact video timestamps unavailable; not estimated.

*Research limitations: The character wiki was available through indexed excerpts but its live page could not be opened. No verified secret identity or additional spoken dialogue was established.*
